from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
ws=Path('results/business/goodbooks_10k/task1/codex_20260618_144747/workspace')
clean=pd.read_csv(ws/'cleaned_books_analysis.csv')
initial_pool=pd.read_csv(ws/'first_review_pool.csv')
def pct(s, asc=True):
    return (s if asc else -s).rank(method='average', pct=True)*100
floor=clean['ratings_count'].quantile(.60)
overall=(clean['average_rating']*clean['ratings_count']).sum()/clean['ratings_count'].sum()
clean['exposure_aware_quality_value']=(clean['average_rating']*clean['ratings_count'] + overall*floor)/(clean['ratings_count']+floor)
clean['exposure_aware_quality_score']=pct(clean['exposure_aware_quality_value'], True)
clean['exposure_aware_quality_contribution']=0.20*clean['exposure_aware_quality_score']
clean['exposure_aware_review_score']=0.34*clean['demand_absolute_score']+0.24*clean['exposure_gap_score']+0.22*clean['genre_scarcity_score']+0.20*clean['exposure_aware_quality_score']
active=clean[clean['language_known'] & clean['publication_year_known'] & clean['main_genre'].notna()]
dthr=active['demand_absolute_score'].quantile(.8)
cap=active['ratings_count'].quantile(.85)
pool=active[(active['demand_absolute_score']>=dthr)&(active['ratings_count']<=cap)].copy().sort_values(['exposure_aware_review_score','book_key'], ascending=[False, True])
print('floor', floor, 'overall', overall, 'active', len(active), 'pool', len(pool), 'dthr', dthr, 'cap', cap)
print('initial top15')
print(initial_pool.head(15)[['book_key','title','first_review_score','quality_score','average_rating','ratings_count']].to_string(index=False))
print('\\nnew top15')
print(pool.head(15)[['book_key','title','exposure_aware_review_score','demand_absolute_score','quality_score','exposure_aware_quality_score','average_rating','exposure_aware_quality_value','ratings_count']].to_string(index=False))
init_top10=set(initial_pool.head(10).book_key.astype(int))
new_top10=set(pool.head(10).book_key.astype(int))
print('entered', [int(x) for x in pool.head(10).book_key if int(x) not in init_top10])
print('left', [int(x) for x in initial_pool.head(10).book_key if int(x) not in new_top10])
# print ranks for top20 union
initial_rank=dict(zip(initial_pool.book_key.astype(int), range(1,len(initial_pool)+1)))
new_rank=dict(zip(pool.book_key.astype(int), range(1,len(pool)+1)))
changed=list(new_top10-init_top10)+list(init_top10-new_top10)
print('changed ranks:')
for k in changed:
    row=clean.loc[clean.book_key==k].iloc[0]
    print(k, initial_rank.get(k), new_rank.get(k), row.title, 'demand', row.demand_absolute_score, 'quality old/new', row.quality_score, row.exposure_aware_quality_score, 'score old/new', row.first_review_score, row.exposure_aware_review_score)
PY"
